source: HAND-BUILT from the Cloudflare API reference (https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/). Cloudflare's current official MCP server (https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp) exposes only three tools (search, execute, docs) using Code Mode, so it cannot supply ~20 typed tools. The older product-specific servers are deprecated and have no zone/DNS/cache tools. These 20 tools are what a native typed Cloudflare MCP would plausibly expose: one tool per common REST operation, parameter names taken from the REST path and body fields. Names and descriptions are written here, not copied from a server.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all accounts you have ownership or verified access to.

per_page.description: Maximum number of results per page.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List, search, sort, and filter the zones (domains) in your account.

name.description: A domain name. Only zones with this exact name are returned.

account_id.description: Only return zones owned by this account ID.

status.description: Zone status filter: initializing, pending, active or moved.

tools.name: get_zone
tools.description: Get the details of a single zone by its zone ID.

tools.name: purge_cache
tools.description: Remove cached content for a zone. Purge everything, or purge selectively by URL, cache tag, hostname or URL prefix. Purging everything may temporarily increase load on your origin.

purge_everything.description: Set to true to purge all cached content for the zone. Cannot be combined with files, tags, hosts or prefixes.

files.description: Full URLs of individual files to purge.

tags.description: Cache-Tag values whose cached files should be purged.

hosts.description: Hostnames whose cached files should be purged.

prefixes.description: URL prefixes (without scheme) whose cached files should be purged.

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: List, search, sort, and filter the DNS records of a zone.

type.description: Record type filter, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

name.description: Exact record name filter, e.g. www.example.com.

proxied.description: Filter by whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare.

tools.name: create_dns_record
tools.description: Create a new DNS record for a zone.

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

name.description: DNS record name (or @ for the zone apex).

content.description: Record content, e.g. an IPv4 address for an A record.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. 1 means automatic.

proxied.description: Whether the record is receiving the performance and security benefits of Cloudflare.

priority.description: Required for MX, SRV and URI records.

comment.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record.

tools.name: update_dns_record
tools.description: Update an existing DNS record. Only the fields provided are changed.

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT.

name.description: DNS record name (or @ for the zone apex).

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds. 1 means automatic.

proxied.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare.

comment.description: Comments or notes about the DNS record.

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record from a zone.

tools.name: get_zone_setting
tools.description: Get the value of a single zone setting, for example ssl, min_tls_version, always_use_https or development_mode.

setting_id.description: Setting name, e.g. ssl, min_tls_version, always_use_https, development_mode.

tools.name: update_zone_setting
tools.description: Update the value of a single zone setting, for example turn development mode on or change the SSL mode.

setting_id.description: Setting name, e.g. ssl, min_tls_version, always_use_https, development_mode.

value.description: New value for the setting, e.g. on, off, full, strict, 1.2.

tools.name: list_rulesets
tools.description: List the rulesets (redirect, cache, WAF, rate limiting and other rules) configured for a zone.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

per_page.description: Maximum number of rulesets to return.

tools.name: list_workers_scripts
tools.description: List the Workers scripts deployed in an account.

tools.name: delete_workers_script
tools.description: Delete a Workers script from an account.

force.description: If true, delete the script even if it is still bound or has active deployments.

tools.name: list_kv_namespaces
tools.description: List the Workers KV namespaces in an account.

tools.name: create_kv_namespace
tools.description: Create a Workers KV namespace.

title.description: A human-readable name for the namespace.

tools.name: list_r2_buckets
tools.description: List the R2 buckets in an account.

name_contains.description: Only return buckets whose name contains this string.

per_page.description: Maximum number of buckets to return.

tools.name: create_r2_bucket
tools.description: Create an R2 bucket.

locationHint.description: Location hint for the bucket: apac, eeur, enam, weur or wnam.

tools.name: list_d1_databases
tools.description: List the D1 databases in an account.

name.description: Only return databases with this name.

tools.name: query_d1_database
tools.description: Run a single SQL query against a D1 database and return the result rows.

params.description: Positional parameters bound to ? placeholders in the query.

tools.name: list_pages_projects
tools.description: List the Cloudflare Pages projects in an account.
